comparison.objective: Uniformly heat-shrink a sleeve over a cable lug while rotating the cable and sweeping a heat gun.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate cable rotation with progressive noncontact heating while controlling distance, dwell, and hot-tool safety.
comparison.success_condition: All sleeve regions recover uniformly with sealed ends, no charring or contact damage, and the switched-off gun is returned safely.
comparison.reason: This tests distributed thermal-process control, not mechanical support continuity and bearing-element containment. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
